items.text: Meat Canning Factory

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Well, well, look who we 'ave here. A tiny squirt bold enough to come sniffing around for my finest treasure.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Uh, sorry, but it's just—

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: You will address me as "Packleader"!

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: Right, Packleader!

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: Yes, Packleader! We weren't trying to sneak a bite outta the cans, honest!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: I'm not talking to you two mutts! Go gnaw a bone somewhere else!

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: Yes, Packleader! Right, Packleader.
Flutterpage and Lamplighter watch in silence as the two dogs scamper off with their tails between their legs.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Yes, Packleader. The truth is, I just need to borrow your treasure for a minute.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: You see some sneaky little fairies nicked my name, and they've got a knack for hiding the things they steal in what other people treasure most. So, I'm just checkin' if it's here.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: And why do you think they enjoy hiding their spoils in such objects?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I s'pose it's 'cause if it's worth somethin', they'll keep it tucked away, safe and sound, won't they?

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Exactly.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Whatever troubles you've got with those little mischief-makers is none of my business. You can borrow my treasure, but it'll cost you.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Prove yourself to me in a one-on-one challenge! If you succeed, my finest treasure will be yours ... to borrow.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Flutterpage ...
Lamplighter casts a worried glance at Flutterpage. A one-on-one competition against such a powerful, hulking hound hardly seems like the best course of action.
After a brief moment of thought, Flutterpage nods her head with determination.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I know, Lamplighter, but it's better than coughin' up more cash. I'm game.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But one thing—I get to choose the competition. Sound good to you?

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Ready or not, here I come!
At the sound of Girt's voice echoing through the factory, Flutterpage, curled up in a hidden nook, presses a hand to her mouth to hide her laughter.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Heh. No way she's ever gonna find me here.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I'm the hide-and-seek champ. One time, no one found me till it was already pitch dark and everyone just bogged off home.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Cor, look at all these tins! Jellied eels, Sunday roast, toad-in-the-hole, steak and kidney pie ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Wow! Shepherd's pie! That's my favorite! I wonder if it tastes as good in a tin as the real thing?

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: You aren't the only one! Every one of us pups is dying to know what it tastes like!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Where'd you lot come from?!

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: Shh! Keep it down, or you'll get us caught.

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: You think you're safe here? Hah! We can smell you a mile away!

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: Our leader's nose is the best there is. Her sniffer's tracked down more troublemakers than we can count!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Oh. You're right. You lot are dogs! I can't stick around here, so where should I go?
After exchanging a glance, the little dogs wag their tails.

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: If you can do us a little favor ...

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: We might be able to help you!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: The reek of an old collar, worthless. A bottle? Not there either. Eh? What do we have here?

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Tattered clothes, ink and scraps of paper, the wind's breath, and a hint of bird ... Aha!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: You lose, runt. I've found you!
Girt hurls the obstacle before her aside, only to reveal an empty corner.
All that remains is a lone pair of familiar shoes and socks.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Huh?

items.speaker: Pack Hound I & II
items.text: Now!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Attack!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Huh?!
Boom! Flutterpage kicks up a cloud of dust as she crashes down from above, executing a perfect ambush.
Flutterpage rises over Girt, who is still sprawled out and dazed beneath her, triumphantly dusting off her skirt.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: That's the funny thing about searching—no one ever remembers to look up, not even dogs.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: I can't believe it. You actually beat Girt!

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: Nice one! We finally got one over on our leader!

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: Yeah, we really did! Flutterpage, you'd better keep your promise!
The pups bound and bark with joy around Flutterpage, while their leader snarls, springing to her feet in fury.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Y-You little runts! What do you think you're doing?!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Aha! I see now. You two must've teamed up with this little squirt to sneak a bite from our tins.

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: You've got it wrong, Packleader! You always treat us like we're still wet behind the ears!

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: We ain't gonna steal tins no more, Packleader! We're good for something! Look, we even caught you off guard!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Yes, Packleader Girt. They weren't helping me just so they could nick a can of food. All they wanted in return was ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: ... for me to be their witness, while they proved to you that they're right clever little puppies!

items.speaker: Pack Hound I
items.text: That's right. We're clever little puppies! We won't steal a bite from any of the cans, and we can still lend you a paw, Packleader!

items.speaker: Pack Hound II
items.text: So how about taking us along on the next hunt? We hate being left behind waiting for everyone to get back.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: You clueless little mutts! Don't you realize that all I do is for your own good?!

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Tsk ...

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: So be it. I've lost, fair and square.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Bring out the treasure.
The calmer of the two puppies wags its tail, carrying over a sturdy-looking fang.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: This is the fang I lost in a scrap with that Black Dog of Newgate a few years back.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: It was my sharpest fang, but I won the day.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: My fangs and claws are what made me the boss here. I've always counted on them to help me whenever there's a problem.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: This fang is a proud reminder of that.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: But, maybe it's made me a bit too proud.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: Maybe I can do an even better job of being the boss around here without it. So, take it.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: You sure? This thing seems proper special to ya.

items.speaker: Packleader Girt
items.text: You think I'm the type to second-guess myself? Let's not drag this out.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Alright, no point arguing, I s'pose. It looks proper fierce, after all! This could be exactly what I need.
As Flutterpage expects, once she accepts the fang, those familiar glimmers surround her again.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Wow! The fifth letter! It's here!

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Just two more to go.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: We're making decent progress. You even charmed your way past Packleader Girt.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Let's see where them glow bugs are pointing to next. Eh?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Funny, they're still heading east. But there's nothing else east on Cross Street, right?
As their eyes meet, they come to realize what this means.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I'm thinking ... That means the rest of my name's not on Cross Street, don't it?
Lamplighter bright face darkens into a frown.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: It's out there, where the Bananach dwells.
